chapter: Early jobs and Johnny Lee Long show
title: Favorite drummer Red Happy and early bands
summary: His favorite drummer was Red Happy of the Lyric Theater; he played with Kid Howard before going on the road.

bands.name: Johnny Lee Long and His Playmates

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Any other early bands you can remember playing with or also the ones that you heard when you were about that age? Well... Who was your favorite drummer, for instance? Who did you ever watch or see?
My favorite drummer was a drummer at the Lyric Theater, which was Happy.
Yeah. Red Happy. That's right. Red Happy.
Yeah. A lot of people talk about him.

He was my favorite drummer. Well, after a while, I played around with a couple of bands, like, well, like Kid Howard. I played with Kid. And I was still a youngster. And I had an opportunity to leave home, to go on the road with a show. For my first job, I left here with Johnny Le Long and his playmates. On the Lyric Theater.
